bound_or_value.quantity: maximum corrected load in complete lot Mica

satisfied_premises: The complete lot consists of R and S.
Corrected load equals recorded load minus assigned profile bias.
Both exact calibrations match Mica, 2031-06-18, and glims.
next_check: None is needed; the applicable exact calibrations determine both corrected loads.
rationale: Acceptance requires every corrected load to be at most 14 glims. The matching exact calibrations fix copper bias at 1 and jade bias at 4, giving R a corrected load of 13 glims and S a corrected load of 15 glims. S exceeds the limit, so acceptance fails in every state compatible with the accepted evidence. HOLD applies to the complete two-piece lot.
